top.line: An iPad to review the book
top.para: An iPad app built to review the book: PDFs read properly, comments and cards on the page, append lanes, JSON tied to the graph, a vault opened with my passkey, sgit in Swift, and a meter; the March desktop app gives the account and pipeline, but this one should be native.

in-short.para: The iPad as a book; Preview in the way; an app to review the book; comments on the page; JSON; a passkey vault with sgit in Swift; a meter; the March app.

why.para: It has nothing else on the screen; reviewing RC1 and its companion there showed Preview's gaps and a review split across two PDFs.

desk.line: The book app as a review desk
desk.para: A library, a proper PDF reader, comments and cards on the page, highlights and votes, append lanes in and out, and pull and push from the site, all as JSON tied to the graph.

projection.para: If the app draws the comments, the PDF, the website and the app are each one projection of the content, the start of a better way to read the book.

vault.line: A vault that opens with my passkey
vault.para: A passkey's PRF secret, offered to apps since iOS 18, derives a key on the device that unwraps the vault key; native, so no web view question; tested first, with a QR recovery key.

swift.para: sgit has two implementations; a native Swift one would be a third, and every disagreement is a gap in the documentation.

meter.para: Every page, graph and navigation costs a little, against credits that can go negative; the reader pays for use and is the customer, not the product.

march.para: SGraph Desktop: a signed, notarised macOS app in a day, an Android launch in two, an iOS pipeline and shell, and a team; the account and pipeline carry over, the web-view architecture does not.

native.para: PDFKit for the PDF, AuthenticationServices for the passkey, Swift for sgit, and a web view only for the web.

plan.para: Test PRF first, then the reader, the review, sgit in Swift and the meter, built on macOS runners and delivered by TestFlight.

limits.para: Nothing is built; PRF is untested on my iPad; no Swift sgit exists; the March iOS build is not recorded on a device; my interest.

sources.para: My voice memo of 31 October, the SGraph-AI__Desktop repository at its last commit, and Apple's PRF documentation.
